purpose: Login flow UI: Home screen, Login form, Dashboard (auth-required), LockedNotice. The navigation graph is model-checked — Dashboard is provably unreachable without an Active session.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Public landing; shows 'Sign in' for unauthenticated users.

screens.name: LockedNotice
screens.purpose: Shown when login fails because the account is locked.

requirements.description: While on Home, when the user clicks 'Sign in', the system shall navigate to Login.

meaning.text: From the home page, the Sign in button takes the user to the login page. Nothing else happens yet — no credentials have been entered.
meaning.author: agent

requirements.description: While on Login, when the user submits valid credentials, the system shall navigate to Dashboard.

meaning.text: A user who enters credentials that check out is taken straight to the dashboard; the login page does not stay in the way.
meaning.author: agent

requirements.description: If the user submits credentials for a Locked account, then the system shall navigate to LockedNotice.

meaning.text: If the credentials belong to an account that has been locked, the user is sent to a page that tells them so, rather than to the dashboard or back to a login form that will never work.
meaning.author: agent

ears.trigger: the user submits credentials for a Locked account

invariants.description: Dashboard is reachable only when authenticated == true. ('Shall always' statements are invariants, not requirements — Apalache proves them across all reachable states.)

decisions.title: Model the navigation as a Quint state machine
decisions.decision: Encode screens as a variant type, navigation as Quint actions, auth gating as invariants checked by Apalache.
decisions.rationale: Lets us prove 'Dashboard unreachable without auth' rather than relying on convention. Visual design stays in the design tooling — not formalized.
